script.title: Boolean Algebra: De Morgan's Laws
learningObjectives: Apply De Morgan's laws to a Boolean expression

sections.heading: Complement of a sum
sections.explanation: The complement of an OR expression equals the AND of the complemented terms: NOT(A OR B) = NOT A AND NOT B.

sections.heading: Complement of a product
sections.explanation: The complement of an AND expression equals the OR of the complemented terms: NOT(A AND B) = NOT A OR NOT B.

keyTakeaways: Complementing an OR changes it to AND and complements each input.
Complementing an AND changes it to OR and complements each input.

scenes.title: De Morgan's laws
scenes.narration: Use De Morgan's laws to transform complemented Boolean expressions.

scenes.title: Complement a sum
scenes.narration: When the whole sum is complemented, complement each variable and replace OR with AND.

scenes.title: Apply the second law
scenes.narration: For a complemented product, complement each variable and replace AND with OR.

scenes.title: Quick recall
scenes.narration: Which operator replaces AND when the entire product is complemented using De Morgan's second law?
